_comment_1: Copy this file to scripts/sanitize-map.json and replace the keys with the real literals from YOUR environment. sanitize-map.json is git-ignored and must never be committed: its keys ARE the sensitive values.
_comment_2: Format is a flat object of {"literal to find": "replacement"}. Keys are matched as plain substrings, not regex. Order does not matter. Use RFC 5737 documentation addresses (192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24) as replacements.
